content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text resolves a collision by treating the lack of an explicit textual resolution of paternity as making the point underdetermined, which is the chain-versus-verse weighing rule K-C governs.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "The phrase 'no one of them states the contrary in its own words' could be read as (1) absence of a contrary stating verse does not by itself decide or make the issue underdetermined, or (2) absence of an explicit verse resolving the point leaves it underdetermined; I adopted the first reading under K-C's chain-by-footing command.", "why": "K-C retires the stating-verse test and requires chain-against-chain weighing by footing, but the judge text labels the issue underdetermined for lack of explicit textual resolution of paternity."}
